title: Predicator conformance authored analysis case
description: An authored case in conformance/analysis/cases.json, before mix corpus.generate completes it. A case names a program; the expected answers are always computed, never authored. See conformance/README.md, "The analysis surface".

id.description: Human-chosen, path-like, unique, stable forever, always under analysis/. Never renamed once shipped.

source.description: A predicator program (an expression is a program of one statement). Exactly one of source or instructions is present.

instructions.description: A raw instruction list, tagged-value encoded, for a case no source compiles to. Exactly one of source or instructions is present.

notes.description: Free text carried into the shipped analysis corpus.
